page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It includes a bundled 1919 GB local SSD storage volume and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. The virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the ecs.i2ne.2xlarge sits primarily in the lower performance tiers for compute-heavy tasks. Both single-core and multi-core CPU benchmarks from stress-ng and Geekbench place the instance in the bottom 25%. Similarly, single-threaded gzip compression is categorized in the bottom 10%, and bzip3 decompression is in the bottom 25%. However, the instance demonstrates average performance in large-block memory bandwidth tests (both read and write) and Passmark CPU scores, which fall into the middle 50%. LLM inference speeds for a small 135M model are also average, though performance drops to the bottom 10% for a medium 7B model.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.i2ne.2xlarge is its modest CPU compute capability relative to its generous memory allocation and substantial local SSD storage. While raw processing speeds are limited, the combination of 64.0 GB of RAM and nearly 2 TB of local SSD storage makes this instance qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require high storage density and memory capacity without demanding intense CPU cycles. It is suitable for database hosting, caching layers, and storage-heavy applications where local disk access speed and memory capacity are prioritized over high-performance compute.
